label: Държавен вестник — no issue in the window
text: ДВ бр. 99 от 30.10.2026 is still the newest issue and its official section holds weapons, waste, rail transport, КС децисия № 17/2026 and ПП № 223/26.10.2026 — no КТ, ЗДДС, ЗПС or labour-migration act, and the €660 minimum-wage ordinance is still not promulgated.
